title: Scale-Split Neural Operator for Memory- and Data-Efficient 3D Turbulence Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2609.38977v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Neural surrogates have emerged as fast alternatives to the numerical simulation of three-dimensional turbulence. However, training them at high resolution remains challenging, since the memory of full-field models grows with the resolution. In addition, full-resolution training data are expensive to simulate and store, and therefore scarce. We introduce ScaleSplit-NO (Scale-Split Neural Operator), which exploits the scale structure of turbulence with two neural operators: a Parent predicts the global coarse field at the next time step, and a Child predicts full-resolution local patches conditioned on this prediction. Neither model operates on the full-resolution field. The Child is pretrained alone and then attached to the Parent's coarse prediction through zero-initialized connections. On two complex high-resolution turbulence benchmarks, ScaleSplit-NO surpasses all competing baselines in both prediction accuracy and data efficiency.

translated_title: 用于内存与数据高效三维湍流预测的尺度分离神经算子
translated_abstract: 神经代理模型已成为三维湍流数值模拟的快速替代方案。然而，在高分辨率下训练这些模型仍然具有挑战性，因为全场模型的内存需求会随分辨率增长。此外，全分辨率训练数据的模拟和存储成本高昂，因此十分稀缺。我们提出了ScaleSplit-NO（尺度分离神经算子），它利用湍流的尺度结构，采用两个神经算子：一个父模型预测下一时间步的全局粗粒度场，一个子模型以该预测为条件预测全分辨率的局部patch。两个模型都不直接处理全分辨率场。子模型先单独预训练，然后通过零初始化连接与父模型的粗粒度预测相连接。在两个复杂的高分辨率湍流基准测试中，ScaleSplit-NO在预测精度和数据效率方面均超越了所有竞争基线。
tldr: 提出ScaleSplit-NO，采用父-子双神经算子架构分别预测全局粗粒度场和局部全分辨率patch，避免任何模型直接处理全分辨率场，从而实现了内存与数据高效且精度更高的三维湍流预测。
en_tdlr: ScaleSplit-NO introduces a parent-child dual neural operator design that separately predicts global coarse fields and local full-resolution patches without ever processing the full-resolution field, achieving memory- and data-efficient yet more accurate 3D turbulence prediction.
